Slope of line 1 is −a/6. Set −a/6 = −3/2 and solve: a = 9

opts: a, so the lines are parallel

ch: A new fertilizer causes taller tomato plants.

qs.trap: √2 goes with 45-45-90; √3 goes with 30-60-90.

qs.q: In a right triangle, sin(76°) = 28/53. What is cos(14°)?
qs.tool: Rule: sin(x°) = cos(90° − x°) (complementary angles).
steps: sin of one = cos of the other
qs.trap: Do not compute anything; the angles add to 90°.

qs.q: A right triangle has legs of length 20 and 21. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
qs.tool: Reference sheet: a² + b² = c².
qs.trap: Square, add, THEN take the square root.

qs.q: In right triangle WXY, angle Y is the right angle. The side opposite angle W has length 45, the side adjacent to angle W has length 28, and the hypotenuse has length 53. What is sin(W)?
qs.tool: SOH-CAH-TOA: Sin = Opp/Hyp, Cos = Adj/Hyp, Tan = Opp/Adj.
qs.trap: Sin and cos both use the hypotenuse; pick the right leg. SOH-CAH-TOA.

qs.q: The circumference of a circle is 67π inches. What is the diameter of the circle, in inches?
qs.tool: Rule: C = πd, so d = C ÷ π.
qs.trap: Do not type 67π as a decimal (210.5). They asked for the diameter: 67.

qs.q: A circle has a radius of 2. A central angle measures 30°. What is the sector area of the part of the circle cut off by this angle?
qs.tool: Rule: fraction of the circle = angle ÷ 360.
qs.trap: Divide the angle by 360, not 180.

qs.q: The equation of a circle in the xy-plane is x² − 10x + y² + 10y + 46 = 0. What is the radius of the circle?
qs.tool: Desmos: type the equation, read the radius off the graph. Or complete the square.
steps: Complete the square for x: x² − 10x → (x − 5)², add 25
qs.trap: The right side is r². Take the square root.

qs.q: A line is tangent to a circle with center O at point T. The radius OT is 16. Point P is on the tangent line, and TP = 30. What is the distance OP?
qs.tool: Rule: a tangent line meets the radius at a RIGHT angle → Pythagorean theorem.
steps: Radius ⟂ tangent: triangle OTP has a right angle at T
qs.trap: Tangent + radius = right angle. That is the whole trick.
